dish: Otaru ankake yakisoba (house noodles from the Abe Seimen mill)
n: Otaru Ankake-dokoro Tororian (小樽あんかけ処 とろり庵)
w: The ankake-yakisoba specialist run by the old Abe noodle mill — crisp-fried noodles under a thick, generous seafood-and-vegetable sauce.

n: Chūka Shokudō Keien (中華食堂 桂苑)
w: An arcade Chinese diner packed even on weekdays for the city's soul-food plate of fried noodles under thick ankake.

dish: nigiri from a third-generation Otaru chef
w: Tucked down an alley off Sushiya-dōri — a meticulous third-generation counter with nigiri sets from about ¥2,000.
